How This Hub Was Built (Steamgears Workshop, Aabenraa, October 2026)

Every guide linked here was built and photographed in the Steamgears workshop in Aabenraa during 2026: the $7 can-lid goggle build, the $38 thrifted reference outfit, the under-$100 three-tier workshop plan and the twelve last-minute Halloween looks were all assembled on the same bench, priced in US dollars and timed with a kitchen timer. The hub is updated whenever a new guide is published, so this page is always the shortest path to our newest build.

What do I need for a basic steampunk costume?

Three layers: a neutral base, one Victorian silhouette piece (waistcoat, corset or long skirt) and gear — goggles, a pocket watch, gloves or a hat. Our beginner guide lists exact items.

Can I build a steampunk costume cheaply?

Yes. The $40 outfit formula shows which pieces to buy, which to thrift and which to build. For a complete weekend build with three budget tiers, follow our steampunk costume under $100 workshop plan.

Are goggles necessary?

No, but they are the fastest way to signal “steampunk”. Build your own with the DIY goggles guide.

items.description: Every great steampunk story needs a backdrop. Our steampunk posters and wall art turn bare walls into airship decks, inventor workshops and clockwork laboratories — no glue gun required. Each design in this collection is original artwork built around the things that make the genre tick: interlocking brass gears, riveted copper plating, gaslit Victorian streets and airships drifting over a foggy harbor. If you love the aesthetic but do not have the hours to build a full costume, a poster is the fastest way to bring the retro-futurist mood home. Original Steampunk Artwork, Made to Print Every piece starts as a hand-guided digital illustration in our workshop — never mass-market clip art. We design around classic steampunk iconography: mechanical hearts, blueprint schematics, clockwork creatures and industrial machines with a story behind every rivet. The posters are drawn to look like artifacts from an alternate 19th century, where the steam engine never gave way to the silicon chip. That means warm brass tones, sepia textures, engraved linework and typography-free artwork, so nothing on your wall fights with the rest of your decor. Two Sizes, Printed to Order Choose the format that fits your space: 30×40 cm for shelves, hallways and gallery walls, or 50×70 cm when a piece needs to hold a whole room on its own. Every print is produced to order — we do not hold stock, so there is no warehouse fading and no old inventory. Your poster is printed when you order it, packed for transport and shipped fresh from production. Standard frame sizes mean you can pick up an off-the-shelf frame and hang it the same week it arrives. Where Steampunk Wall Art Works Best Steampunk decor thrives in rooms where you want atmosphere and conversation. Hang a single 50×70 cm print above a desk or workbench as a focal point, or build a gallery wall by mixing two or three 30×40 cm prints with props — an old pocket watch, a pair of goggles on a hook, a brass compass. Game rooms, home offices, workshops, bars and bedrooms all take the style well, because the palette of bronze, sepia, leather brown and deep teal is easy to live with. It reads as vintage industrial rather than costume-shop fantasy, so it works even if the rest of your home is strictly modern. Posters Built From the Same World as Our Shop The artwork on this page belongs to the same universe as our steampunk t-shirts, hoodies and goggles — designs that appear on a poster on Monday can sit next to the shirt that inspired them on Friday. Pair a print with a full outfit for conventions and photo shoots, or let it stand alone. If you are decorating for a themed party, a poster is the cheapest and fastest way to commit to the theme without renovating anything. Not Sure Where to Start? Our steampunk costume ideas guide shows how the designs connect across the whole store, and the DIY steampunk goggles guide is the natural companion project for a workshop wall. Building a look for someone else? A print plus a tee makes a ready-made gift set for the steampunk fan in your life — check the steampunk gifts collection for bundles that pair well together. The print itself matters as much as the art. We use a bright white poster stock with a matte finish that keeps engraved linework crisp and does not glare under shop lights or desk lamps — the look stays true whether it hangs opposite a window or above a reading chair. Colors are printed with a wide gamut so the deep teals and glowing copper highlights survive the transfer from screen to paper, and each size is scaled from the master file, not cropped, so the composition you see in the shop is the composition on your wall. Posters also solve the eternal gifting problem: what do you buy the person who already owns every pair of goggles? A print is personal without being a sizing gamble. There are no measurements to take, no color that might not suit — just pick a design that matches their obsession, whether that is airships, clockwork anatomy or pirate skyships, and let the paper do the talking. Rolled in protective packaging, it arrives ready to frame, and a frame is usually the only thing standing between your order and a finished wall. Scroll down, pick your size and give your walls the steam treatment. New designs join the collection regularly — bookmark the page and check back before you redecorate.
